rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for tea as a drink and can also mean tea leaves or a type of tea.

example.english: I like drinking tea most in the morning.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ziu1 zou2 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 jam2 caa4

rows.note: Use this specifically for an afternoon tea occasion or light afternoon meal.

example.english: Let’s have afternoon tea together at three.
example.traditional: 三點鐘我哋一齊食下午茶啦。
example.jyutping: saam1 dim2 zung1 ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 sik6 haa6 ng5 caa4 laa1

rows.note: Use this when English tea means the main evening meal rather than the drink.

example.english: We have tea at half past six.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 luk6 dim2 bun3 sik6 maan5 faan6
